notes: Spec merged as 64b6052 (#215) before the pipeline started. D-3/D-4 decided by owner: take the full window -> 10,240 words / 30,720 bytes. | Baseline corrected: 3,883 passed at 810c911 (my 3,879 brief figure was stale, from REQ-591's pre-D-6 tip). | D-4 REVERSED (ADR-9, 2026-08-26): byte half back to LOCAL_BUDGET_BYTES 32,768; pair is (10,240, 32,768). The reported /analyze turn (4,097 w / 31,014 B) SERVES.
verifyNotes: TASK-271 residual: COMPACT_OUTPUT_MAX_BYTES restates window_pair's byte formula rather than reading a shared accessor — two numbers on one chain, which is the LESSON-491 shape the task cited. Held together only by an equality assertion against derive's own answer. If a `pub const fn` for the local pair lands in budget.rs, the ceiling should read it. Check in verify.

ADR-6a: AC-4 is tautological once the byte half is derived (usable <= usable). It guards the coupling, not the bound. A green AC-4 is NOT evidence the budget fits the engine — BR-7's witnesses are AC-9's real-tokenizer measurement and the engine's own over_window.

AC-9 MEASURED (TASK-273): numeric_grid.txt — 10,240 words / 20,480 bytes / 20,480 real o200k_base tokens = 1.33x the 15,360 usable window. BOTH harness guards admit it. Not cherry-picked: random, sparse and run-heavy grids of the same shape all measure exactly 2.000 tok/word, because o200k_base tokenizes every digit AND every separating space. Must land in ADR-6 (deferred only because TASK-275 held architecture.md).

ADR-6 CORRECTION NEEDED: the zero slack is STRUCTURAL, not a consequence of the 3/2 ratio. window_pair computes words = usable x den/num and the claim is words x num/den, so the ratio cancels — slack is 0 at every ratio and every reservation. Only an explicit margin (which D-3 declined) creates any. ADR-6 currently implies the ratio is the lever; it is not.

ADR-6 OVERSTATES THE SAFETY NET: it says REQ-589's offer plus the engine's typed refusal are the catches. The offer CANNOT fire for this class — skill_fit/skill_refusal raise it only when a SKILL EXPANSION exceeds the budget, and here both harness guards admit the content, so the harness believes the turn fits. Only the engine's ContextWindowExceeded (completion.rs:243) catches it, as a bare refusal. Verify should decide whether that is acceptable or whether the local tier needs a pre-flight token check.

TASK-273 note: numeric_grid joins base64 in KNOWN_UNCOVERED_AT_PINNED_FLOOR — REQ-586's combined estimate now has two documented gaps. base64 spends its byte budget fast so a full-budget turn of it is small; this one is byte-light, so a full-budget turn is admitted whole.

AC-10(a) MEASURED (M5 Max, real llama.cpp+Metal, n_ctx=16384): 6,164 tok -> 3,111 ms; 15,410 tok -> 13,548 ms. Ratio 4.35x, NOT the ~2.5x the spec predicted — attention's quadratic term; per-token cost 0.454 -> 0.877 ms/tok across 3k-15k. Full-budget turn costs ~+10.5 s to first token.

AC-10(b) FAILED AS WRITTEN: 12,885 ms first token vs the 1,000 ms max_first_token_ms bound (benchmark.rs:42). Fails on first-token latency, NOT on min_tokens_per_sec (decode holds 79-82 tok/s, ~16x above the 5.0 floor). CONTEXT THAT MATTERS: the duty is a short-prompt model-selection gate run once post-download, never per turn, and today's 4,096-word budget ALREADY costs ~3.1 s at full budget — 3.1x over. The duty never covered full-budget turns.

AC-11 CORRECTS D-3's HEADLINE: 'holds ~2.5x more conversation' is true in ONE currency only. under_pressure is a disjunction over both halves and the crossover density moves 8 B/word -> 3 B/word, so real content flips from word-bound to BYTE-bound and the byte threshold FELL 6.25% (22,937 -> 21,504). Measured turns-to-pressure: 1.56x at 4 B/word, 1.11x at 6, 1.00x at 8, 1.00x at 20. D-4's byte regression reaches the COMPACTION threshold, not just BR-7's refusal band.

*** THE REQ AS BUILT DID NOT FIX ITS OWN MOTIVATING CASE (TASK-272). *** The reported /analyze body is 4,097 words / ~31,014 bytes (7.57 B/word). Before: refused by 1 WORD, fit on bytes with 1,754 spare. After the derived pair: fits on words with 6,143 spare, refused by 294 BYTES. The refusal moved halves. Crossover: the new pair beats the old only below 7.5 B/word — prose (5) +50%, code (8) -6.25%. Verify must confirm the reversal actually lands this.

D-4 REVERSED mid-Phase-4 (owner did not answer; proceeding, cheap to undo). Byte half returns to LOCAL_BUDGET_BYTES 32,768; word half stays derived at 10,240. Evidence the reduction bought nothing: numeric_grid (the pathological class) is 20,480 B, admitted at BOTH values, and overruns the engine regardless — no byte value in this range catches it. Side benefit: the compact ceiling (30,720) then sits 2,048 B under the budget, so BR-9 holds with room rather than exactly zero. NOTE: D-4 was MY inference from the owner's 'full window', not their explicit decision.

TASK-272 finding, unfixed and pinned: at the boundary the over-budget offer quotes two IDENTICAL byte figures ('about 4,097 words / 31 KB, and the budget is 10,240 words / 31 KB') because bytes_figure rounds to the nearest KB. The user cannot see which currency refused them.

TASK-272 finding: the word budget rose 2.5x but discovery's SKILL_MAX_BYTES (64 KiB) did not. 10,240 words above ~5.1 B/word no longer fits in a SKILL.md at all, and the failure surfaces as 'no skill you can dispatch' rather than anything about a budget. Two fixtures now assert the ceiling. Candidate follow-up REQ.

TASK-274 + TASK-276 DONE (2026-08-26). D-4 reversal finished: 15 red tests resolved. AC-12's witness renamed the_reported_analyze_measurement_serves_on_both_halves_of_the_local_pair and grew a 4th leg carrying the report's OWN byte figure (4,097 w / 31,014 B) -- the three boundary legs it had would all pass under D-4 too, so only that leg can tell the two states apart. ANSWER: the reported turn SERVES, 6,143 words and 1,754 bytes spare.

AC-7 is VOID (no byte band exists after ADR-9) and nothing was written against it. Its real content -- 'do not pin only the improving direction' -- is carried by AC-12's one-byte-apart legs and by AC-11's 8/20 B/word rows, which now assert after == before where under D-4 they asserted after <= before. requirement.md AC-7 says so.

AC-16 implemented in bound_clause: 'bound: local engine - the word half comes from the engine's 16,384-token window, less the 1,024 reserved for the reply; the byte half is fixed'. Figures interpolated from the constants. The byte half is named as NOT derived, which is the honest half after ADR-9. AC-6 mutation (fold LocalEngine into bound_clause's DefaultUnknown arm) RUN and CONFIRMED RED on both tests; reverted by re-editing the line.

AC-11 RE-MEASURED after the reversal: 15 / 11 / 8 / 4 turns (was 14 / 10 / 8 / 4 under D-4). Byte compaction threshold back to 22,937 (D-4 had it at 21,504) and the digest byte threshold back to 12,000 (D-4: 11,250). architecture.md's table carries both columns.

FIXTURE HAZARD, hit twice and now guarded: sizing a local over-budget body as 2x the pair lands on discovery's SKILL_MAX_BYTES (64 KiB) exactly, and the skill is SKIPPED -- every test then fails with 'no skill you can dispatch' rather than anything about a budget. over_the_local_pair() and oversized_for_the_local_pair() now size at 1.25x words / 4 B per word and assert both ceilings. This is the same SKILL_MAX_BYTES squeeze TASK-272 flagged as a candidate follow-up REQ; it is now load-bearing for the test suite too.

TASK-272's rendering finding STANDS and is pinned, not fixed: at the byte boundary the offer quotes two identical KB figures ('about 4,097 words / 33 KB, and the budget is 10,240 words / 33 KB') because bytes_figure rounds to the nearest KB. A user at that boundary cannot tell which currency refused them. Changing the figure's precision is a decision about every budget sentence, not this one.
ownerDecisionsPending: Full window vs trim, given prefill is 4.35x not 2.5x and compaction gain is 1.1-1.6x not 2.5x. PROCEEDING ON: keep the full window (D-3 unchanged). Rationale: prefill scales with what a turn actually sends, not with the ceiling, so ordinary turns are unaffected; the 1,000 ms duty was already 3.1x over at full budget before this REQ; the motivating /analyze case serves at ~3.1 s.

AC-10(b) recording. PROCEEDING ON: leave it UNTICKED and record the failure plus its context, rather than rewording a criterion after watching it fail — that is the AC-8 shape LESSON-560 describes and this session has already caught twice.

D-4's reversal was made without an owner answer (as D-4 itself was). It is recorded as ADR-9 with the measurement, and is cheap to re-reverse. The owner decision that was actually made is D-3 (the full window for the WORD half); D-4 was inferred from it.
